1. The description goes as music instruments made from the intestine of a dead monkey.
2. 2 Categories : Rababa and Been
3. Original description "A monkey has been disemboweled while jumping from tree to tree. Once the intestine dried, a wise man attached it to a stick and a gourd, creating the first instrument. Instruments developed from this, called the rebab and the vina, are held by the musicians who sit beneath the trees."
And this is beautiful. A simple construct of string under tension producing music later gets refined. With been, meend is Lateral. Ghaseet is longitudenal. With Rabab, meend and ghaseet both are longirudenal. And hence less textural possibility (Last statement is my interpretation)
4. To observe "The rebab-player sits on the left, while the vina-player is on the right."
